segments.headline: Tata Steel deal draws questions · Tata Trusts move High Cour
segments.cap: A ₹28,000 crore Tata deal is under fire. And the Tata family fight has reached court.
segments.tts: [excited] A twenty-eight thousand crore rupees Tata deal is under fire. And the Tata family fight has reached court.

segments.headline: Tata Steel deal draws question
segments.cap: Proxy advisers want SEBI to look closely at the ₹28,000 crore Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. APL Apollo would buy two Tata Steel businesses, paid for with debt. Tata Steel would also buy the promoters' stake for ₹15,510 crore. APL Apollo shares have fallen more than 30% since the deal was announced.
segments.tts: [excited] Proxy advisers want SEBI to look closely at the twenty-eight thousand crore rupees Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. APL Apollo would buy two Tata Steel businesses, paid for with debt. Tata Steel would also buy the promoters' stake for fifteen thousand five hundred ten crore rupees. APL Apollo shares have fallen more than thirty percent since the deal was announced.

head: IS THE DEAL
FAIR?
beats.note: Advisers say the *linked parts* of the deal should be *judged together.*

head: APL BUYS
TATA UNITS
beats.note: The purchase is *funded with debt,* which public shareholders of APL Apollo will *carry.*

head: TATA BUYS
PROMOTERS' STAKE
beats.note: Tata Steel gets *control* of the tubes maker by buying out the *promoters.*

head: SHARES
DOWN 30%+
beats.note: Tata Steel says it is *examining the concerns* raised by investors.

segments.headline: Tata Trusts move High Court
segments.cap: Tata Trusts have gone to the Bombay High Court. They challenge the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman. The court hears the case on Friday, before the Tata Sons board meeting on 30 November. The trusts also seek damages of ₹50 crore and ₹15 crore.
segments.tts: [excited] Tata Trusts have gone to the Bombay High Court. They challenge the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman. The court hears the case on Friday, before the Tata Sons board meeting on the thirtieth of November. The trusts also seek damages of fifty crore rupees and fifteen crore rupees.

head: TATA VS
TATA?
beats.note: The trusts say the *September 17 vote* did not get the *required support.*

head: HEARING
ON FRIDAY
beats.note: The trusts want *no casting vote* by the chairman at the *30 November* board meeting.

head: DAMAGES
SOUGHT
beats.note: Two trusts ask for *₹50 crore* and *₹15 crore,* plus 18% yearly interest.

segments.headline: Nvidia pauses Asia shipments
segments.cap: Nvidia has asked partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. Dell and Supermicro told buyers their orders will not be sent. This follows new US export curbs on advanced AI chips. It is unclear if the pause is temporary.
segments.tts: [excited] Nvidia has asked partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. Dell and Supermicro told buyers their orders will not be sent. This follows new US export curbs on advanced AI chips. It is unclear if the pause is temporary.

head: NVIDIA HITS
PAUSE
beats.note: Shipments of *servers with its chips* to *four countries* are on hold.

head: ORDERS
NOT SENT
beats.note: These firms *package the chips* into servers and *told buyers* the orders will not ship.

head: NEW US
EXPORT CURBS
beats.note: Washington wants to shut *routes* Chinese firms may use to get *advanced AI chips.*

head: TEMPORARY
OR NOT?
beats.note: Reports say it is *not clear* how long the *halt* will last.
